theme: A day on the water, the errands on land
greeting: Good day, Dan. You're mid-charter with the girls back with Jen, so the calendar is clear and the day belongs to the boat. The open items are all ashore, and none of them are on fire.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Todoist flags the full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week as due today. It's the hardest rental in that market over the holidays and it sells out early. A refundable hold now costs nothing and the dates can flex later.

needsAttention.title: Croatia disembark logistics
needsAttention.detail: The Cavtat transfer, bag hold, and an early express checkout for the pre-dawn Sept 19 departure still need arranging from dry land. Charter connectivity is thin, so worth catching in a port window rather than leaving to the last morning.

needsAttention.title: Sept 20 landing stack
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20 to Oct 5 SUV and the two-night St Pete gap before Orlando are still open before you land TPA on the 20th. The St Pete Airbnb was left pending a host confirmation, worth a glance that it actually converted.

flagged.title: Philip is checking in from Maine
flagged.detail: An old friend wrote wondering where you've been and floating a get-together. He sails Saturday for two weeks in the Med, so a quick reply before then closes the window.

flagged.title: A LinkedIn message is waiting
flagged.detail: LinkedIn says Megan messaged you and it's still unanswered, worth opening given you're actively networking.

flagged.title: Card balance ticked down
flagged.detail: A myFICO alert notes your JPMCB card balance decreased. Informational, nothing to act on.

inbox.noise: The usual newsletters, Responsible Investor, the WSJ tech roundup, NYT Cooking and Daily Italian, plus a Conqueror sale and a Todoist digest.

recipe.title: Pork chops with roasted beets & escarole salad
recipe.why: Early autumn brings in the first beets and bitter chicories worth roasting and searing against a good chop.

acts.line: An open, meeting-free day, rare and yours, somewhere off the Croatian coast.
The only real pull is toward dry land and a signal, where the week's loose ends live.
Nothing on the calendar tonight; the water sets the pace, not a clock.
